/* Generated by Lowdefy build */
@layer theme, base, antd, components, utilities;

properties.subTitle: Sorry, the page you are visiting does not exist.

url.description: An external URL to link to.

newWindow.description: Open the link in a new window.

input.description: Input to pass to the linked page.

replace.description: Replace the current history entry instead of pushing a new one.

scroll.description: Scroll to the top of the page after navigating. Defaults to true.

darkMode.description: Set dark mode preference. When not provided, cycles through light, dark, and system.

hazards.message: Content is sanitised with DOMPurify, so <style>, <script> and inline event handlers are removed before render. Clicks are wired through data-event attributes instead of inline handlers.
Add data-confirm="Delete this row?" to a data-event element whose event deletes or changes data, so a stray click cannot fire it. Only OK fires the event.
Content is rendered without sanitising, so never pass caller-supplied or database HTML through it. Use Html for anything a user could have written.
DOMPurifyOptions is read once when the block mounts, so a value that changes after the first render has no effect. Set it statically or remount the block.

Content is sanitised with DOMPurify, so <style>, <script> and inline event handlers are removed before render. Use DangerousHtml for a trusted <style> block, or style the block through its style and class properties.
Html fires no events from its markup: data-event attributes do nothing here. Use ClickableHtml for clickable elements, including icons.

Link to app pages with <a data-page-id="page-id" data-url-query="key=value">, not <a href="/page-id?key=value">. A hard-coded href reloads the whole app on click, ignores basePath and is not checked by the build. Use data-new-tab, not target="_blank", which sanitising removes.
Show statuses with Approved or Syncing, not inline-styled pills or hex status colours. data-tag and data-status follow the theme and dark mode and match the ag-grid tag cells.

onClick.description: Trigger actions when the Box is clicked.

onPaste.description: Trigger actions when the element is focused and a paste event is triggered.

ariaLabel.description: Arial-label to apply to link tag.

back.description: When the link is clicked, trigger the browser back.

urlQuery.description: When the link is clicked, pass data as a url query to the next page.

icon.description: Icon name (a semantic name like `edit`, a Lucide icon name like `Pencil`, or a set-qualified name like `tabler:Pencil`) or properties of an Icon block for anchor icon.

url.description: External url to link to when the anchor link is clicked.

rel.description: The relationship of the linked URL as space-separated link types.

newTab.description: Open link in a new tab when the anchor link is clicked.

replace.description: Prevent adding a new entry into browser history by replacing the url instead of pushing into history. Can only be used with pageId link and newTab false.

scroll.description: Disable scrolling to the top of the page after page transition. Can only be used with pageId link and newTab false.

title.description: Text to display in the anchor.

onClick.description: Called when Anchor is clicked. Renders a shortcut badge when a shortcut is configured.

html.description: Content to be rendered as Html. An element with a data-event attribute fires the event it names when clicked (data-event="onEditClick" fires events.onEditClick), and its default browser action is prevented. The event object holds the element's other data-* attributes with snake_case keys, so data-event="onEditClick" data-record-id="42" gives { record_id: "42" }. Targets that are not links or buttons become keyboard focusable, and Enter or Space clicks them. A data-event inside popover content fires too, then closes the popover. A link with data-event fires the event and does not navigate. data-confirm="Delete this row?" on a data-event element asks first: only OK fires the event (bare data-confirm asks "Are you sure?"). All Html block attributes work too: data-icon, data-tooltip, data-popover, data-page-id links, data-new-tab, data-tag, data-status, data-time, data-format, data-avatar, data-copy, data-truncate and data-tone. See the HTML attributes docs page.

onTextSelection.description: Trigger action when text is selected and pass selected text to the event object.

html.description: Content to be rendered as Html. The Html block attributes (data-icon, data-tooltip, data-popover, data-page-id links, data-new-tab, data-tag, data-status, data-time, data-format, data-avatar, data-copy, data-truncate, data-tone) work here too, unless DOMPurifyOptions removes data attributes.

DOMPurifyOptions.description: Customize DOMPurify options. Options are only applied when the block is mounted, thus any parsed settings is only applied at first render.

endpointId.description: Required. The api endpoint that resolves this block content at page get. InternalApi endpoints are recommended.

params.description: Static values passed to the endpoint payload as params. Operators are not allowed — read runtime values in the endpoint routine with _payload, _user or _secret.

required.description: When true, a resolution failure fails the whole page request instead of rendering the fallback slot.

types.description: Extra block, action and operator types the endpoint may return, so build includes them in the client bundle.

blocks.description: Block types the endpoint may return.

actions.description: Action types the endpoint may return.

operators.description: Client operator types the endpoint may return.

onClick.description: Trigger actions when the Dynamic container is clicked.

html.description: Content to be rendered as Html. It understands these attributes: data-icon="edit" renders an icon (a semantic name like edit, delete or warning, or a Lucide icon name like Pencil); data-tooltip="Text" shows a tooltip on hover and focus; data-popover="id" toggles a popover showing the element with data-popover-content="id" (mark it hidden); links to an app page without reloading (never hard-code href="/page"); data-link opts an existing app-relative into the same navigation; data-new-tab opens a link in a new tab (target is stripped by sanitising); data-tag="success" renders a tinted status tag and data-status="success" a status dot (tones success, processing, info, warning, error, default, an antd preset colour, a CSS colour, or any other value to seed a stable colour); renders a date as relative, date, datetime, time or a dayjs format; data-format="currency" data-currency="USD" formats the element's number as number, currency, percent, compact or bytes; data-avatar="Jane Doe" renders initials (on an , a fallback for a broken image; never use an avatar image service); data-copy adds a copy button for the element's text or the attribute's value; data-truncate="2" clamps block text to 1–6 lines with the full text in a tooltip when cut off; data-tone="secondary" colours text with a theme tone (secondary, tertiary, quaternary, success, warning, error, info). See the HTML attributes docs page.

onTextSelection.description: Trigger action when text is selected and pass selected text to the event object.

name.description: Icon name: a semantic name like `edit`, a Lucide icon name like `Pencil`, or a set-qualified name like `tabler:Pencil`. Add your own semantic names with `theme.icons.aliases`.

nonScalingStroke.description: Keep the stroke width constant at any icon size. Defaults to `theme.icons.nonScalingStroke`.

rotate.description: Number of degrees to rotate the icon.

strokeWidth.description: Stroke width of the icon lines, in pixels of the 24px icon grid. Defaults to `theme.icons.strokeWidth` (2).

disableLoadingIcon.description: While loading after the icon has been clicked, don't render the loading icon.

onClick.description: Trigger actions when icon is clicked. The icon then takes keyboard focus, and Enter or Space trigger it too.

alt.description: Alternative text description of the image.

crossOrigin.description: Indicates if the fetching of the image must be done using a CORS request.

decoding.description: An image decoding hint to the browser. Sync for atomic presentation with other content, async,  to reduce delay in presenting other content and auto leave to browser to decide.

loading.description: How the browser should load the image. Eager loads the image immediately, lazy, defers loading until the image it reaches a calculated distance from the viewport, as defined by the browser.

sizes.description: Indicating a set of source sizes of strings separated by commas.

srcSet.description: Possible image sources for the user agent to use, strings separated by commas.

direction.description: List content along a 'row' or down a 'column'. Applies the 'flex-direction' css property to the List block.

wrap.description: Specifies wrapping style to be applied to List block as 'wrap', 'nowrap' or 'wrap-reverse'. Applies the 'flex-wrap' css property to the List block - defaults to 'wrap', requires List direction to be set.

scroll.description: Specifies whether scrolling should be applied to the List, can be true or false. Applies the 'overflow' css property to the List block - defaults to 'visible', requires List direction to be set.

onClick.description: Trigger actions when the List is clicked.

interval.description: Milliseconds to wait after the `onTick` actions of one tick finish before the next tick fires. Changing it while the timer is waiting restarts the wait.

autoStart.description: Start ticking when the block mounts. Off by default, so the timer is started with the `start` method.

maxTicks.description: Stop the timer after this many ticks. The `onTick` event of the last tick is still triggered. Unlimited by default.

pauseWhenHidden.description: Pause ticking while the browser tab is hidden (`document.visibilityState`), and resume when it becomes visible again. Ticks missed while hidden are not fired on resume; the next tick fires `interval` ms after the tab is visible.

description.description: Trigger actions on every tick while the timer is running. The next tick is scheduled `interval` ms after the `onTick` actions finish, so ticks never overlap.

event.tick: The number of ticks since the timer was started, starting at 1.
